hook: Euler wrote most of his work after going blind

beats.say: Leonhard Euler lost one eye at thirty-one and the other at fifty-nine, then kept working.
54 percent of the works in the standard catalogue of his writings came after his second eye failed in 1766.
He raised 13 children, often working with a baby on his lap, and it took 79 years after his death to finish printing what he left.
